stayVoucher.title: Booking voucher
stayVoucher.footer: Present this voucher at check-in. Check-in and check-out times are set by the property.
stayVoucher.subject: Your booking voucher {{reference}}
stayVoucher.body: Your booking is confirmed. Your voucher is attached to this email.

stayCancellation.title: Cancellation confirmation
stayCancellation.footer: This confirmation records the cancellation of your booking. Any amount due is payable at the property under its cancellation policy.
stayCancellation.subject: Cancellation of your booking {{reference}}
stayCancellation.body: Your booking has been cancelled. The confirmation is attached to this email.

stayDamageClaim.title: Damage claim notice
stayDamageClaim.footer: You may dispute this claim before the dispute deadline by replying through your booking messages. The amount is payable at the property, not through {brand}.
stayDamageClaim.subject: Damage claim notice for booking {{reference}}
stayDamageClaim.body: A damage claim has been raised for your recent stay. The notice is attached to this email.
